description.narrative: Contract related to: Integrated Response Mechanism for Ukraine - This 18-month measure aims to respond to locally identified needs through a flexible rapid response mechanism that will source and then deliver items to where they are needed. A first component of the action will provide support to authorities and other key stakeholders to help them continue operating in high-risk environments. This will include procurement of equipment for civilian use and the provision of further assistance. The aim is to enhance the delivery of basic services to meet critical needs at national, regional or local level, including in areas affected by active fighting. This may include, but is not limited to, threat detection equipment, possibly including drones, radio and communication equipment, specialised personal protective equipment and other larger items such as generators, solar panels, etc. In light of the fast-changing needs in the ongoing crisis situation, sufficient flexibility to respond to a variety of civilian equipment needs will be provided. A second component of the action responds to a request from the Ukrainian government to provide support for the protection and safeguarding of cultural heritage items and sites in the country. This may include, but is not limited to, the documentation of assets and providing equipment for the protection, storage and, where needed and feasible, evacuation of cultural heritage goods.1st Non-Substantial Amendment: This is to allow the exceptional delivery of equipment to the Republic of Moldova, as necessary to respond to the impact of related military and hybrid attacks on its territory (component 2: ¿Support to Ukrainian Authorities to respond to locally identified needs¿). Due to itsborder with Ukraine and integrated electricity grid, the Republic of Moldova has recently been facing blackouts in conjunction with hybrid attacks. This has severly limited the internal security forces and emergency services in their response capability. The situation constitutes an acute threat to the stability of the country in direct relation to Russia¿s unprovoked and unjustified war of aggression in Ukraine. The present situation makes it necessary to exceptionally extending initial support to Ukrainealso to the Republic of Moldova as necessary to respond to the impact of related military and hybrid attacks on its territory.
